00047 LinPan2UGenInternal::LinPan2UGenInternal(UGen const& input, UGen const& position, UGen const& level) throw()
00048 : ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, 1)
00049 {
00050   inputs[Input] = input;
00051   inputs[Position] = position;
00052   inputs[Level] = level;
00053 }
00054 
00055 void LinPan2UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00056 {
00057   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00058   float* outputSamples0 = proxies[0]->getSampleData();
00059   float* outputSamples1 = proxies[1]->getSampleData();
00060   float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00061   float* positionSamples = inputs[Position].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00062   float* levelSamples = inputs[Level].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00063   
00064   ugen_assert(*positionSamples >= -1.f && *positionSamples <= 1.f);
00065   
00066   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00067   {
00068     float pos1 = *positionSamples++ * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00069     float pos0 = 1.f - pos1;
00070     float inputValue = *inputSamples++ * *levelSamples++;
00071     
00072     *outputSamples0++ = inputValue * pos0;
00073     *outputSamples1++ = inputValue * pos1;
00074   }
00075 }

00077 
00078 LinPan2::LinPan2(UGen const& input, UGen const& position, UGen const& level) throw()
00079 { 
00080   initInternal(2);
00081   
00082   UGen inputChecked = input.mix();
00083   UGen positionChecked = position.mix();
00084   UGen levelChecked = level.mix();  
00085   
00086   LinPan2UGenInternal*  internal = new LinPan2UGenInternal(inputChecked, positionChecked, levelChecked);
00087   internalUGens[0] = internal;
00088   internalUGens[1] = internal->getProxy(1);
00089   
00090   float pos1 = positionChecked.getValue(0) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00091   float pos0 = 1.f - pos1;
00092   float inputValue = inputChecked.getValue(0) * level.getValue(0);
00093   
00094   internalUGens[0]->initValue(inputValue * pos0);
00095   internalUGens[1]->initValue(inputValue * pos1);
00096 }

00101 Pan2UGenInternal::Pan2UGenInternal(UGen const& input, 
00102                    UGen const& position, 
00103                    UGen const& level) throw()
00104 : ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, 1),
00105   panTable(Buffer::getTableConstantPan512()),
00106   lastPos(position.getValue(0) * 0.5f + 0.5f),
00107   last0(panTable.lookup(0, lastPos)),
00108   last1(panTable.lookup(1, lastPos))
00109 {
00110   inputs[Input] = input;
00111   inputs[Position] = position;
00112   inputs[Level] = level;  
00113 }
00114 
00115 void Pan2UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00116 {   
00117   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00118   float* outputSamples0 = proxies[0]->getSampleData();
00119   float* outputSamples1 = proxies[1]->getSampleData();
00120   float pos = *(inputs[Position].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0)) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00121   float* levelSamples = inputs[Level].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00122     
00123   if(pos == lastPos)
00124   {
00125     if(inputs[Input].getNumChannels() <= 1)
00126     {
00127       float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00128       
00129       while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00130       {
00131         float inputValue = *inputSamples++ * *levelSamples++;
00132         
00133         *outputSamples0++ = inputValue * last0;
00134         *outputSamples1++ = inputValue * last1;
00135       }
00136     }
00137     else 
00138     {
00139       float* inputSamples0 = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00140       float* inputSamples1 = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 1);
00141       
00142       while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00143       {
00144         float level = *levelSamples++;
00145         float inputValue0 = *inputSamples0++ * level;
00146         float inputValue1 = *inputSamples1++ * level;
00147         
00148         *outputSamples0++ = inputValue0 * last0;
00149         *outputSamples1++ = inputValue1 * last1;
00150       }
00151     }
00152 
00153   }
00154   else
00155   {
00156     float posInc = (pos - lastPos) / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00157     
00158     if(inputs[Input].getNumChannels() <= 1)
00159     {
00160       float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00161 
00162       while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00163       {
00164         lastPos += posInc;
00165         float inputValue = *inputSamples++ * *levelSamples++;
00166         
00167         last0 = panTable.lookup(0, lastPos);
00168         last1 = panTable.lookup(1, lastPos);
00169         
00170         *outputSamples0++ = inputValue * last0;
00171         *outputSamples1++ = inputValue * last1;
00172       }
00173     }
00174     else
00175     {
00176       float* inputSamples0 = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00177       float* inputSamples1 = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 1);
00178       
00179       while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00180       {
00181         lastPos += posInc;
00182         float level = *levelSamples++;
00183         float inputValue0 = *inputSamples0++ * level;
00184         float inputValue1 = *inputSamples1++ * level;
00185         
00186         last0 = panTable.lookup(0, lastPos);
00187         last1 = panTable.lookup(1, lastPos);
00188         
00189         *outputSamples0++ = inputValue0 * last0;
00190         *outputSamples1++ = inputValue1 * last1;
00191       }
00192     }
00193     
00194     lastPos = pos;
00195   }
00196 }

00198 
00199 Pan2::Pan2(UGen const& input, UGen const& position, UGen const& level) throw()
00200 {   
00201   initInternal(2);
00202   
00203   UGen positionChecked = position.mix();
00204   UGen levelChecked = level.mix();
00205   
00206   Pan2UGenInternal*  internal = new Pan2UGenInternal(input, positionChecked, levelChecked);
00207   internalUGens[0] = internal;
00208   internalUGens[1] = internal->getProxy(1);
00209   
00210   float posValue = positionChecked.getValue(0) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00211   float pos0 = internal->getTable().lookup(0, posValue);
00212   float pos1 = internal->getTable().lookup(1, posValue);
00213   
00214   if(input.getNumChannels() <= 1)
00215   {
00216     float inputValue = input.getValue(0) * levelChecked.getValue(0);
00217     internalUGens[0]->initValue(inputValue * pos0);
00218     internalUGens[1]->initValue(inputValue * pos1); 
00219   }
00220   else
00221   {
00222     float inputValue0 = input.getValue(0) * levelChecked.getValue(0);
00223     float inputValue1 = input.getValue(1) * levelChecked.getValue(0);
00224     internalUGens[0]->initValue(inputValue0 * pos0);
00225     internalUGens[1]->initValue(inputValue1 * pos1);  
00226   }
00227 }
